newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer, others down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer, others down on profit taking.

text.p: Shares of Pfizer Inc and other major U.S. drug companies fell in busy trading Wednesday as investors, uneasy about Tuesday's stock market drop, moved to take profits, traders and analysts said.
"They're just rotating out of these things," a trader said. "They went straight up," he added.
Investors began to worry after the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed down 79.01 points yesterday and fell another 15 points by midday today.
Pfizer fell two to 83-3/8 and Merck & Co Inc lost 1-1/8 to 79-7/8 in active trading.
Bristol-Myers Squibb Co shed 1-5/8 to 113-5/8, Schering-Plough Corp fell 1-5/8 to 67-1/2 and Eli Lilly and Co lost 1-3/8 to 74-1/2.
"It's just profit taking off the recent move in the group," another trader said.
In an unrelated development, Forest Laboratories Inc fell 8-5/8 to 30-1/8 after the company forecast operating losses for the next two quarters and for all of fiscal 1997.
